description: This file defines API endpoints for managing notes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes. It uses FastAPI framework, interacts with a MongoDB database, and includes utility functions for ObjectId parsing and document conversion.

classes.name: DeleteResponse
classes.description: Response returned after successful deletion, indicating whether a note was deleted.

methods.name: ObjectId _parse_object_id(note_id: str)
methods.description: Parses and validates a MongoDB ObjectId from a string, raising HTTP 422 if invalid.

methods.name: NoteOut _note_doc_to_out(doc: dict)
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB document into a NoteOut API model.

methods.name: List[NoteOut] list_notes()
methods.description: Lists all notes sorted by last updated date in descending order.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (MongoDB ObjectId as string)."), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its MongoDB ObjectId.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided data.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (MongoDB ObjectId as string)."), )
methods.description: Updates an existing note by id with provided fields.

methods.name: DeleteResponse delete_note( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (MongoDB ObjectId as string)."), )
methods.description: Deletes a note specified by id.

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.signature: ( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (MongoDB ObjectId as string)."), )

ctags.name: deleted
ctags.pattern: /^    deleted: bool = Field(..., description="Whether a note was deleted.")$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.signature: ( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (MongoDB ObjectId as string)."), )

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.signature: ( payload: NoteUpdate, id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (MongoDB ObjectId as string)."), )
